सैरन्ध्री

SAIRANDHRĪ . The pseudonym assumed by pāñcālī, when the pāṇḍavas lived incognito in the palace of King virāṭa. (See under pāñcālī).

शैरीषक

ŚAIRĪṢAKA . A region in india, celebrated in the Purāṇas. nakula, in the course of his triumphal march in the western regions, conquered this land also. (M.B. Sabhā Parva, Chapter 32, Verse 6).
